items.source:
The name of the field which contains metadata in each time series document. Should not be the id nor timeField() nor point to an array or Collection.
Translation of property names to annotated fieldnames will be considered during the mapping process.
items.translation:
包含每个时间序列文档元数据的字段名称。不应为 id，也不应为timeField()，且不能指向数组或Collection。
在映射过程中，属性名称将被翻译为注释字段名。

items.source:
Name of the property which contains the date in each time series document.
Translation of property names to annotated fieldnames will be considered during the mapping process.
items.translation:
包含时间序列文档中每个日期的属性名称。
在映射过程中，将考虑对属性名称的翻译为 注释字段名。

items.source:
The collection the document representing the entity is supposed to be stored in. If not configured, a default
collection name will be derived from the type's name. The attribute supports SpEL expressions to dynamically
calculate the collection based on a per-operation basis.
items.translation: 实体所应存储的集合。若未配置，则默认从类型名称派生集合名称。该属性支持 SpEL 表达式，以便根据每个操作动态计算集合。
